name: Ruined City of Dranik
summary: A devastated warzone of collapsed citadels, Discord ruptures, Muramite patrols, and temporal echoes.
description: The Ruined City of Dranik is the shattered heart of the Dranik civilization. Discord energy tears through broken streets, temporal fractures replay ancient battles, and Muramite forces maintain brutal control. Riftseekers maintain fragile arcane anchors to prevent total planar collapse.
